starterRainbows.title: Energy Boost
starterRainbows.description: A daytime starting point built around everyday nutrition. No caffeine, no automatic iron, no promise of an instant lift.
starterRainbows.rationale: B12, C and magnesium anchor the idea. CoQ10 and beetroot are optional candidates; their studied preparations and doses still need checking. Persistent fatigue needs assessment, not an iron guess.
starterRainbows.food: Start with regular meals, beans, eggs or other protein foods, vegetables and adequate sleep.
starterRainbows.caveat: A complete seven-ingredient blend has not been clinically tested. Correcting an inadequate intake is different from boosting energy in a well-nourished person.

starterRainbows.title: Beauty
starterRainbows.description: A nutrition-led skin, hair and nails concept, with a vitamin C foundation and no high-dose beauty claims.
starterRainbows.rationale: Vitamin C supports normal collagen formation; that does not prove this tape improves appearance. Collagen source, dose and allergen suitability remain open. Excess selenium can harm hair and nails.
starterRainbows.food: Prioritise protein foods, colourful vegetables, fruit, nuts and seeds before adding supplements.
starterRainbows.caveat: No skin, hair or nail outcome is established for this seven-ingredient concept. We do not add high-dose retinol by default.

starterRainbows.kicker: An idea for your next chapter
starterRainbows.description: A starting point for adults 60+, with B12 at its centre. Age alone does not tell us what you need.
starterRainbows.rationale: B12 from fortified foods or supplements may be relevant in later life. We leave out routine iron, retinol, iodine and K2. This is not an AREDS formula or a treatment for eye or bone disease.
starterRainbows.food: Build around protein foods, calcium-rich foods, vegetables and fortified foods where appropriate.
starterRainbows.caveat: Medicines, kidney function, existing supplements and individual needs must be reviewed before use. No formula is suitable for everyone over 60.

starterRainbows.title: Mood & Sleep
starterRainbows.description: An evening-themed daily nutrition concept. No melatonin, no 5-HTP, and no ginseng in the same rainbow.
starterRainbows.rationale: Only L-theanine and tart cherry are included as wind-down candidates. The other ingredients provide the daily-nutrition theme. Magnesium evidence for insomnia is limited; this blend is not a treatment for low mood or insomnia.
starterRainbows.food: Keep a regular sleep schedule, reduce evening caffeine, and eat regular balanced meals.
starterRainbows.caveat: Seven ingredients are a design format, not seven proven sleep aids. Preparation, dose, tolerability and bedtime suitability remain to be reviewed.

starterRainbows.title: Everyday Essentials
starterRainbows.description: A simple foundation to explore alongside your diet. A shorter rainbow can be the right choice too.
starterRainbows.rationale: This is a broad nutrition concept, not evidence that every adult needs all seven. Probiotic strain, viable count at end of shelf life and tape-process stability remain unresolved.
starterRainbows.food: A varied diet comes first; use fortified foods or supplements to address a relevant gap.
starterRainbows.caveat: No deficiency assessment or personal dose is provided. All final amounts remain pending.

starterRainbows.title: Active Days
starterRainbows.kicker: For the days you keep moving
starterRainbows.description: A movement-themed starting point with muscle, protein and everyday nutrition in mind.
starterRainbows.rationale: Magnesium and D3 anchor the nutritional theme. Beetroot, CoQ10 and collagen are candidates, not a verified endurance or recovery claim at the reference quantities.
starterRainbows.food: Prioritise adequate food, protein, fluid and recovery around physical activity.
starterRainbows.caveat: A tape cannot replace meals, hydration or recovery. Performance and recovery outcomes have not been established for this blend.

starterRainbows.title: Gut & Immune
starterRainbows.description: A gut-and-immune themed idea, with everyday nutrients and two preparation-specific candidates.
starterRainbows.rationale: Probiotic and beta-glucan effects depend on the exact preparation. We cannot transfer a study on one strain or extract to any tape bearing the same ingredient name.
starterRainbows.food: Start with fibre-rich foods, a varied diet and fermented foods if tolerated.
starterRainbows.caveat: No infection-prevention or gut-disease treatment claim. Immunocompromised people need professional review before probiotic use.
